name: Linkora- AI Bio Page Builder
description:
Linkora is a powerful bio link platform designed for creators, entrepreneurs, and digital brands.
It allows you to create a personalized, mobile-optimized landing page where you can showcase all your important links in one place.                                                                                                                                                                                                                               
 With Linkora, you can:
* Add multiple links
* Customize your profile
* Share one smart link in your bio
* Control access with secure plans
* Build a professional online presence
Linkora helps you turn your single bio link into a powerful digital hub.
